# A `=` inside an HTML tag in a template argument is not a name separator.
#
# `{{#if:1|<div class="x">hi</div>|no}}` used to split at the `=` of
# `class="x"`, so the second argument's *name* became `<div class` and the
# branch value was mangled. The block element then had to be p-wrapped, and
# every page whose first template expands to a `<div>` (Template:Short
# description is the common one) differed from Parsoid from its first byte.
#
# Expectations are the real Parsoid output for the same wikitext.
!! options
parsoid-compatible=wt2html
version=2
!! end

!! test
An ifeq branch holding a div is not p-wrapped
!! wikitext
{{#ifeq:a|a|<div class="x">hi</div>|no}}
!! html
<div class="x">hi</div>
!! end

!! test
Text around an ifeq-expanded div is p-wrapped
!! wikitext
before
{{#ifeq:a|a|<div class="x">hi</div>|no}}
after
!! html
<p>before
</p><div class="x">hi</div>
<p>after
</p>
!! end

!! test
An if branch holding a div is not p-wrapped
!! wikitext
{{#if:1|<div class="x">hi</div>|no}}
!! html
<div class="x">hi</div>
!! end

!! test
A switch branch holding a div is not p-wrapped
!! wikitext
{{#switch:a|a=<div class="x">hi</div>|no}}
!! html
<div class="x">hi</div>
!! end

!! test
A quoted attribute with an equals sign does not split the argument
!! wikitext
{{#if:1|<span title="a=b">hi</span>|no}}
!! html/parsoid
<p><span title="a=b" about="#mwt1" typeof="mw:Transclusion">hi</span>
</p>
!! end
